selection.rule: All IDs in the official MCQA validation list; sort ascending SHA256(seed + newline + video_id), take first 20. No question, label, duration, media or outcome filtering.

evaluation.questions: Every official MCQA question for selected videos, unchanged options/order; gold withheld from prompts and grading until all arms complete.
evaluation.input: Respect official cut-frame mapping before both frame extraction and video inference. OpenAI/Jev get chronological 384px frames sampled every 2 seconds in contact sheets; Gemini gets clipped audiovisual video.
evaluation.metric: Official top-one answer accuracy. Invalid/missing answers count as wrong; report all selected IDs and failures, including budget stops. No comparisons to full-validation leaderboards.
evaluation.prompts: Freeze before the first paid call; no tuning on this sample. No test-time retries.
evaluation.limits: This is a capability audit of input representations/models, not an end-to-end SemVOD retrieval score; public data may have appeared in model pretraining.
